chats.answer:
For outdoor solar lights, AA NiMH rechargeable batteries (1.2V) are usually the best choice. They're commonly used in solar garden lights, pathway lights, and decorative solar lights.

What to look for

Battery type: NiMH (Nickel-Metal Hydride)

Voltage: 1.2V (not 1.5V lithium-ion)

Capacity: 600–1,000 mAh for most small solar garden lights

Size: AA, not AAA

Features: Low self-discharge and good outdoor temperature performance

Important: Check the label on your existing battery. If it says 1.2V NiMH, you can generally replace it with another AA NiMH battery. If it says 3.2V LiFePO4 or 3.7V lithium-ion, you need a different battery chemistry.

Recommended batteries

Best overall: Tenergy Solla AA 1000mAh

Designed specifically for outdoor solar garden lights. 1.2V NiMH, 12-pack.

$16.99 listed

View at Tenergy

Budget option: Geilienergy Solar Light Batteries AA NiMH AA 600mAh 1.2V Rec…

Good for lights originally using 600mAh batteries.

$10.99 · 8-pack

My pick: Tenergy Solla 1000mAh, provided your light supports that capacity. Higher-capacity batteries won't necessarily improve nighttime runtime if the solar panel cannot fully charge them.
